verdict.rationale: WooCommerce's REST API (docs-11, docs-27, docs-44) supports bulk create/read/update/delete of product data via JSON, and WC-CLI (docs-13, probe-4) lets operations staff manage the store from the command line — both enabling bulk catalog operations without per-product UI clicks. However, the evidence pack never cites WooCommerce's native CSV product importer/exporter (a well-known core feature) or any documentation of CSV-based bulk edit workflows, so the 'CSV' half of the story is unevidenced here. Missing for 10: explicit CSV import/export documentation, evidence of bulk-edit UI/tools beyond API/CLI, and independent confirmation of large-catalog performance.
